H1688H.name: Debir
H1688H.brief: Amorite king of Eglon, defeated by Joshua
H1688H.short: Debir was the Amorite king of Eglon who joined a coalition against Joshua but was defeated.

H1683G.name: Deborah
H1683G.desc: Prophetess living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1683G.short: Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried under an oak below Bethel.

H1683H.name: Deborah
H1683H.brief: Prophetess and judge who led Israel to victory over Canaanites.
H1683H.short: Deborah, a prophetess and judge, led Israel to victory against the Canaanites alongside Barak.

H1691.name: Diblaim
H1691.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1691.short: Diblaim was the father of Gomer, the woman whom the prophet Hosea married at God's command.

H1673.name: Doeg
H1673.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1673.brief: Edomite chief shepherd who betrayed David to Saul
H1673.short: Doeg the Edomite, Saul's chief shepherd, witnessed David receiving help from Ahimelech and later betrayed him to Saul, resulting in the massacre of the priests at Nob.

H1603.name: Gaal
H1603.brief: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.
H1603.short: Gaal, the son of Ebed, led a revolt against Abimelech, the ruler of Shechem, but was defeated and driven out of the city.

H1619G.name: Gareb
H1619G.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H1619G.brief: One of David's mighty warriors; an Ithrite.
H1619G.short: Gareb the Ithrite was one of David's mighty warriors, known for his military prowess.

H1636.name: Garmites
H1636.desc: People descended from the area of Garem(?)
H1636.short: The Garmite town of Keilah was founded by a son of Hodiah of Judah.

H1609.name: Gatam
H1609.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1609.brief: Son of Eliphaz; grandson of Esau; Edomite chief.
H1609.short: Gatam was a son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau, and one of the chiefs of Edom.

H1617I.name: Gera
H1617I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1617I.brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin.
H1617I.short: Gera was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.

H1617J.name: Gera
H1617J.short: Gera (or Heglam) was a son of Ehud, a Benjamite, and was among those who were carried into exile.

H1617H.name: Gera
H1617H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1617H.brief: Benjamite; cursed David during Absalom's rebellion; later sought forgiveness.
H1617H.short: Gera was a Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion but later sought forgiveness when David returned to Jerusalem.

H1617G.name: Gera
H1617G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1617G.brief: Descendant of Benjamin; ancestor of Ehud, a judge of Israel.
H1617G.short: Gera was a descendant of Benjamin and an ancestor of Ehud, a left-handed judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression.

H1647G.name: Gershom
H1647G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1647G.brief: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.
H1647G.short: Gershom was the firstborn son of Moses and Zipporah, and his descendant Jonathan served as a priest for the idolatrous Danites.

H1647I.name: Gershom
H1647I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1647I.brief: Descendant of Phinehas; returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.
H1647I.short: Gershom, a descendant of Phinehas, was among the men who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra after the Babylonian exile.

H1648.name: Gershon
H1648.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1648.brief: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.
H1648.short: Gershon was the firstborn son of Levi and the ancestor of the Gershonite Levites, who were responsible for the tabernacle curtains, coverings, and related duties.

H1654.name: Geshem
H1654.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1654.brief: Arab opponent of Nehemiah; tried to hinder wall rebuilding.
H1654.short: Geshem the Arab, along with Sanballat and Tobiah, opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem and tried to intimidate and discourage him.

H1666.name: Gether
H1666.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1666.brief: Son of Aram; grandson of Shem; part of Table of Nations.
H1666.short: Gether was a son of Aram and a grandson of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of the Table of Nations.

H1622.name: Girgashites
H1622.brief: A Canaanite people group living in the Promised Land.
H1622.short: The Girgashites were one of the Canaanite groups inhabiting the land promised to Abraham's descendants.

H1658.name: Gishpa
H1658.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1658.brief: An overseer of the temple servants during Nehemiah's time.
H1658.short: Gishpa was an overseer of the temple servants (Nethinim) during Nehemiah's time.

H1688A.name: Debir
H1688A.brief: Canaanite city captured by Joshua and Caleb's family.
H1688A.short: Debir, also known as Kiriath-sannah or Kiriath-sepher, was a Canaanite city captured by Joshua and later by Caleb's family.
H1688A.meaning: “inner sanctuary”; also called Kiriath-sepher, “city of books”

H1688G.name: Debir
H1688G.brief: A place on the northern border of Judah.
H1688G.short: Debir, a place on the northern border of Judah, distinct from the city of Debir (<ref="Joshua 15:7">Joshua 15:7</ref>).
H1688G.meaning: “inner sanctuary”; also called Kiriath-sepher, “city of books”

H1608.name: Gaash
H1608.brief: Mountain in Ephraim; burial place of Joshua
H1608.short: Gaash, a mountain in the region of Ephraim, was the burial place of Joshua and the homeland of two of David's mighty men.

H1619H.name: Gareb
H1619H.short: Gareb, a hill mentioned in <ref="Jeremiah 31:39">Jeremiah 31:39</ref>, was located near Jerusalem and was to be included within the city's future boundaries.

H1661.name: Gath
H1661.brief: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David
H1661.short: Gath, one of the five major Philistine cities, was the hometown of Goliath and a place of refuge for David during his flight from Saul.

H1662.name: Gath-hepher
H1662.brief: Town in Zebulun; hometown of prophet Jonah
H1662.short: Gath-hepher, a town in the territory of Zebulun, was the hometown of the prophet Jonah.

H1667G.name: Gath-rimmon
H1667G.brief: Levitical city in Dan and Manasseh
H1667G.short: Gath-rimmon, a Levitical city, was allotted to the Kohathite Levites within the territories of Dan and Manasseh.

H1642.name: Gerar
H1642.brief: Philistine city; Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech
H1642.short: Gerar, a Philistine city, was the location of Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech and the site of a battle during King Asa's reign.

H1630.name: Gerizim Mount
H1630.brief: Mountain in Samaria; site of blessings and Jotham's parable
H1630.short: Mount Gerizim, a mountain in Samaria, was designated as the site for pronouncing blessings and was the location of Jotham's parable to the men of Shechem.

H1628.name: Geruth Chimham
H1628.brief: Lodging place near Bethlehem; refuge for Johanan's group
H1628.short: Geruth Chimham, a lodging place near Bethlehem, served as a temporary refuge for Johanan and his group after the murder of Gedaliah.

H1650.name: Geshur
H1650.brief: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom
H1650.short: Geshur, an Aramean kingdom ruled by Talmai, was the homeland of David's wife Maacah and a refuge for Absalom after he murdered his half-brother Amnon.

H1664.name: Gittaim
H1664.brief: Town where Beerothites fled; later inhabited by Benjamites.
H1664.short: Gittaim was a town where the Beerothites fled and was later inhabited by the Benjamites after the Babylonian exile.

H1601.name: Goah
H1601.brief: A place near Jerusalem, mentioned in a prophetic context.
H1601.short: Goah was a place near Jerusalem, mentioned in the context of a prophetic description of the city's future restoration (<ref="Jeremiah 31:39">Jeremiah 31:39</ref>).

H1657G.name: Goshen
H1657G.brief: A region in Egypt where the Israelites settled and prospered.
H1657G.short: Goshen was the region in Egypt where Jacob and his family settled during the time of Joseph, and where the Israelites lived and prospered until the Exodus (<ref="Genesis 45:10; 46:28-29, 34; 47:1, 4, 6, 27; 50:8; Exodus 8:22; 9:26">Genesis 45:10; 46:28-29, 34; 47:1, 4, 6, 27; 50:8; Exodus 8:22; 9:26</ref>).

H1657H.name: Goshen
H1657H.brief: A town and region in the hill country of Judah.
H1657H.short: Goshen was a town and region in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the accounts of Joshua's conquests (<ref="Joshua 10:41; 11:16; 15:51">Joshua 10:41; 11:16; 15:51</ref>).

H1697O.name: Chronicles
H1697O.brief: Historical records of the kings of Israel and Judah
H1697O.short: The Chronicles, mentioned throughout the books of Kings and Chronicles, were historical records of the reigns of the kings of Israel and Judah.

H1665.name: Gittith
H1665.brief: A musical term in the superscriptions of Psalms
H1665.short: Gittith, mentioned in the superscriptions of Psalms 8, 81, and 84, is a musical term of uncertain meaning, possibly referring to a musical instrument, a tune, or a style associated with the city of Gath.
